messages:
Samir (AE): BlueHarbor returned the SIG v2024 spreadsheet. They highlighted tenant isolation, BYOK, and EU-only residency for the POC. Can we do a quick split of who will own each question group?
Maria (SalesEng): I can map questions to our standard answers and populate the evidence column. Need the network diagram and the KMS rotation policy to link.
Aj (Security Eng): I'll draft answers for encryption (rest/in-transit), KMS/BYOK, and key rotation. For BYOK: supported on Private and Dedicated via customer KMS integration; note provider quotas.
Ella (GRC): I'll source SOC2 type II (redacted) and our incident response matrix. Also have a data residency addendum we use for EU obligations.
Samir (AE): BlueHarbor specifically asked if Dedicated + VPC peering is sufficient for their compliance reviewers. Short reply?
Aj (Security Eng): Yes — Dedicated + VPC peering + private control plane meets tenant isolation expectations. Will add a short explanation and point to the dedicated tenancy diagram.
Maria (SalesEng): They also want to know how enabling customer-managed keys affects throughput and any cost impacts during the POC.
Aj (Security Eng): Perf note: envelope encryption adds minimal latency; ~5% CPU overhead on the token path in our tests. Cost note: cloud KMS API calls billed by provider; call this out. No Redwood surcharge unless we provide managed rotation services.
Ella (GRC): For SIG Q18 (incident response), do we share oncall contacts? Our practice: share the escalation matrix and SOC2 contact; named personal info only with contract.
Samir (AE): They asked for an SLA on incident response for Dedicated customers. We have standard SLA docs, right?
Maria (SalesEng): Yes, SLA and escalation matrix are in the Enterprise bundle. I'll link to the SLA PDF and note that Dedicated customers may get tighter response targets under contract.
Aj (Security Eng): I'll attach: kms-rotation-policy.pdf, byok-integration-guide.pdf, dedicated-network-diagram.svg.
Ella (GRC): I'll attach: SOC2-2024-type2-redacted.pdf, incident-response-matrix.pdf, data-residency-addendum.pdf, pentest-summary-redacted.pdf.
Samir (AE): Good. Maria, can you complete the row-level answers and link each artifact in the evidence column? Prefer we produce a single zip they can download.
Maria (SalesEng): Yep. I'll produce the populated SIG spreadsheet and create a zip with all artifacts. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
POC Bot: Created PR-4921 to track SIG deliverables. Reminder scheduled in 24h to check uploads.
Samir (AE): One more item: Q37 is about EU-only hosting for the POC. Aj/Ella, add precise region language we can include.
Aj (Security Eng): Draft language: "EU residency is supported via Dedicated pools deployed in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. For Private deployments, customer controls physical location. Hosted API may serve from the nearest region unless tenancy pinned; recommend Dedicated for EU residency guarantees."
Ella (GRC): I'll add the contractual snippet we use for residency and note required PO terms.
Samir (AE): Anyone blocked?
Maria (SalesEng): Nothing blocking.
Aj (Security Eng): I'll finish the KMS docs this afternoon and upload.
Ella (GRC): Uploading now  will ping once complete.
POC Bot: Upload status: 4/7 artifacts uploaded. Reminder set for Aj in 6h. :white_check_mark:
Samir (AE): Thanks all. I'll notify BlueHarbor that we're compiling the SIG answers and will send the completed package tomorrow EOD. Tag me if they escalate on BYOK or need a named oncall contact. :thumbsup:
